payment_terms.value_text: Payment must be made no later than 30 days from the date of submission of the Stage Payment Statement by the Contractor to the Authority's Engineer.
payment_terms.notes: Clause 17.5.1 on page 76 also provides for an interim 90% advance payment within 10 days of receipt of the Authority's Engineer's recommendation (which is issued within 10 days of statement receipt). The excerpt does not specify whether days are calendar or working days.

retention.value_text: 6% is deducted from each payment for Works, capped at a maximum of 5% of the Contract Price.
retention.quote:
deduct 6% (six per cent) thereof as guarantee money
for performance of the obligations of the Contractor during the Construction Period (the
“Retention Money”) subject to the condition that the maximum amount of Retention
Money shall not exceed 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price.
retention.notes: Clause 7.5.3 allows the Contractor to replace deducted Retention Money with a bank guarantee in tranches of at least 1% of the Contract Price. Balance is refundable within 15 days of the Completion Certificate under Clause 7.5.4. Footnote 5 notes the Authority may omit Clause 7.5 and increase Performance Security instead.

advance.value_text: Advance payment equal to 10% of the Contract Price for mobilisation expenses and acquisition of equipment, carrying simple interest at 8% per annum.
advance.quote:
The Authority shall make an advance payment (the “Advance Payment”), equal to
10% (ten per cent)7 of the Contract Price, for mobilisation expenses and for acquisition
of equipment.
advance.notes: Advance payment is payable in two equal instalments against bank guarantee(s) of 110%. It carries simple interest at 8% per annum (Clause 17.2.1), or 3% per annum above the Bank Rate in case of Termination for Contractor Default (Clause 17.2.6). Annex-III form of guarantee on page 160 mentions an interest-free advance payment of 10% in three instalments.

escalation.value_text: Price adjustment is calculated via index-based formulas (CPI and WPI) using component weightages, with percentages provided in square brackets as placeholders.
escalation.quote: The following percentages shall govern the price adjustment of the Contract Price:
escalation.notes: Clause 17.8 provides price adjustment formulas based on CPI/WPI indices across various work components (Labour, Cement, Steel, Bitumen, Fuel, Other Materials, Plant). Specific component percentages are bracketed placeholders (listed under Appendix-II as provisions with square parenthesis). Additionally, no price adjustment applies to IPCs within 3 months from the Base Date.

performance_security.value_text: The Contractor must provide an irrevocable and unconditional bank guarantee equal to 5% of the Contract Price as Performance Security.
performance_security.quote: The Contractor shall, for the performance of its obligations hereunder, provide to the Authority, within 15 (fifteen) days of the date of this Agreement, an irrevocable and unconditional guarantee, for an amount equal to 5% (five per cent) of the Contract Price, from a Bank
performance_security.notes: Performance Security is a bank guarantee valid until 60 days after the expiry of the Defects Liability Period (can initially be provided for 2 years and extended). An additional performance security of 5% of estimated cost of Structures and Major Bridges applies for the extended Defects Liability Period.
